answer_1.quote: To evaluate the generative capabilities of LLMs using SAPE's prompts, we employed OpenAI's text-davinci-003 model to create synthetic therapy transcripts. ... Psychologists compared SAPE-generated transcripts with those produced using prompts based on Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and Reflexion methods.

answer_4.quote: A group of 8 psychologists ranked each element within these triplets, the ranking was based on the perceived resemblance of the synthetic transcripts to real therapy transcripts. ... The psychologists were instructed to order the dialogues from best to worst based on their similarity to real conversations between patients and professionals.
answer_4.guideline: Rank the dialogues from best to worst based on their similarity to real therapy conversations.
